caption: Figure 1: Contributing participant-days for each primary near-eye and complementary chest model. Participant-level dynamics outcomes use all contributing days to form one fitted observation per participant.
image_alt: A horizontal dot plot shows contributing participant-days for all 17 metrics. Near-eye values range from 655 to 816 days and chest values from 743 to 902 days, with lower support for several sleep, wake, and timing metrics.

caption: Figure 2: Percentage of prepared metric rows retained in the complete site-plus-photoperiod model frame. Losses reflect outcome-specific availability and complete-case predictors; they are not post-fit exclusions.
image_alt: A horizontal dot plot shows model-frame retention for all 17 outcomes. Many outcomes retain all prepared rows, while sleep, wake, dose, and timing metrics retain smaller percentages. Near-eye and chest patterns are similar but not identical.
